map.BP 一般包含哪些必备模块？: Which modules does a BP usually include?
map.主流结构含执行摘要、公司概述、市场与机会（TAM/SAM/SOM）、产品/服务、: The mainstream structure covers executive summary, company overview, market and opportunity (TAM/SAM/SOM), product/service, business model, competitive analysis, team, financial forecast, fundraising plan, and risks with mitigations. Seed and angel rounds can streamline team and product, while growth-stage companies must add unit economics and the scaling path.
map.财务预测写几年合适？: How many years should the financial forecast cover?
map.早期写 3 年（12 个季度）即可，重点在第 1 年逐季、后两年逐年；预测要自下: For an early-stage company 3 years (12 quarters) is enough, focused on each quarter of year 1 and each year for the following two years; build the forecast bottom-up (average order value x customer count x gross margin) rather than guessing, and label the key assumptions (retention, CAC, payback period) so investors can review them.
